description: Make a web map of places, routes or areas, and get a link anyone can open to see it, with no code and no account. Write it as the map document get_map_spec describes. The link works for an hour after the map last changed; opening it, the person can add the map to their squidmaps account to keep it, publish it and share it for good. Returns an id and editToken: keep them, to change this map with update_map rather than making another.

map.description: A squidmaps map document (see get_map_spec): "features" (GeoJSON features, styled with "@" properties), and optionally "name", "description", "basemap", "extent", "view" and "legend".

name: create_map
title: Make a shareable map
